Women's cricket will debut at next year's Commonwealth Games with a re-match of the 2020 T20 World Cup final.The other six teams were chosen based on their place in the ICC T20 rankings as of April 1 last year. [1]

Sources: [1] Australia vs India to kick off Commonwealth Games Women's T20 (cricinfo.com)
